page_title: SEV 2-2 LEG | Sevilla v Leganes 04/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' The corner from Suso (Sevilla) is cleared away by the defence.
90+3' Leganes fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+1' The game is interrupted now, Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90' What a beautiful long-range strike by Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes). He is quite unlucky as his shot flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
89' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
88' Borja Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Munir El Haddadi will be replaced by Roberto Lopez (Leganes).
87' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is caught offside!
85' Yan Diomande (Leganes) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
84' Substitution. Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) on for Alvaro Pascual.
83' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
81' Borja Jimenez has decided to substitute Dani Raba and he is replaced by Diego Garcia (Leganes).
81' That's the end of the game for Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier, who is replaced by Yvan Neyou (Leganes).
80' A yellow card for a tackle by Yan Diomande (Leganes). Alejandro Hernandez doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
80' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) extricates himself from the difficult situation with a good pass, comfortably eluding the pressing opponent.
80' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
76' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) fails to control his temper and is booked by the referee for dissent.
75' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Javi Hernandez (Leganes) for a tough tackle.

73' 2 - 2 Goal – 2:2! Julian Chicco sends a superb cross into the box. Javi Hernandez (Leganes) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header into the top right corner, leaving Orjan Nyland beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish.
70' 2 - 1 Goal! Isaac Romero (Sevilla) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Juanlu Sanchez. The score is 2:1.
70' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Orjan Nyland intercepts the ball.
66' Borja Jimenez prepares a substitution. Duk is replaced by Yan Diomande (Leganes).
66' Juan Cruz comes off the pitch to be replaced by Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes).
62' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Renato Tapia (Leganes), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
60' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
59' Suso (Sevilla) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
59' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Sevilla will take a corner kick.
58' Alejandro Hernandez blows the whistle, Kike Salas (Sevilla) is penalised for a foul. Leganes are awarded a free kick.

58' Alvaro Pascual (Sevilla) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
57' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Suso (Sevilla), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

57' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Marko Dmitrovic makes a great save to stop his effort. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Joaquin Caparros Camino has decided to make a change. Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) replaces Peque.
55' Here comes a substitution. Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is brought on as a substitute for Saul Niguez.
55' Duk (Leganes) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul. Sevilla have been awarded a free kick.
52' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes.
49' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla).
47' Suso (Sevilla) is about to take a corner kick.
47' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Sevilla earn a corner.
47' The foul by Duk (Leganes) was seen by Alejandro Hernandez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Sevilla.
46' Joaquin Caparros Camino has made a change at the break. Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) has come on in place of Jose Angel Carmona.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Peque (Sevilla) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Marko Dmitrovic anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Suso (Sevilla) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
43' Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul after Duk (Leganes) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Sevilla are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
42' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
41' Suso (Sevilla) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
39' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. That's a free kick to Leganes.
38' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
34' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Alejandro Hernandez didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
31' 7:4 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
28' Today's referee Alejandro Hernandez rightly decides to book Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) for his harsh tackle.
27' Suso (Sevilla) takes the corner but it's cleared.
26' Sevilla enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
25' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) tries to find Darko Brasanac, but he puts too much power on the pass.

21' 1 - 1 Goal! Suso launched the corner kick and superbly found the head of Kike Salas (Sevilla), whose accurate effort from near the penalty spot went straight into the bottom right corner. It's 1:1.
21' Suso (Sevilla) steps up to send the ball in.
21' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
18' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
17' Julian Chicco (Leganes) serves up a nice cross, but Orjan Nyland punches the ball away.
15' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic comes off his line to gather the ball.
10' Dani Raba (Leganes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
7' 0 - 1 Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) takes the free kick with a powerful low drive that goes inside the left-hand post and ends up behind the goalkeeper. A real jaw dropper!
7' Leganes have a free kick from a promising distance.
6' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Alejandro Hernandez ignores the protests.
6' Leganes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
4' Sevilla work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
4' Dangerous play by Javi Hernandez (Leganes). Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Sevilla will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
3' Neat passing move from Leganes in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The match has just started.
Leganes will kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
